title: Cryogenic-free Dilution Refrigerator Test for Characterization of Superconducting Detectors and Devices
description_text: NASA/GSFC has a requirement for a Cryogen-free Dilution Refrigerator Test for Characterization of Superconducting Detectors and Devices. This is a combined synopsis/solicitation for commercial items prepared in accordance with the format in Subpart 12.201-1 (Simplified Procedures) as supplemented with additional information included in this notice. This announcement constitutes the only solicitation and quotations are being requested. The following are provided in the attachments: Cover Letter Statement of Work  Section 1 Instructions to Offerors  Section 2 ADDENDUM to 52.212-1 Instructions to Offerors  Commercial Products and Commercial Services. - Solicitation Provisions/Representations and Certifications - Section 3 Clauses/Terms and Conditions  Section 4 Quote Evaluation Criteria  Section 5
